title.de: Irreale Bedingung: if I had, I'd
title.it: Il periodo ipotetico: if I had, I'd
title.en: If I had a boat, I'd row across

goal.sl: Poveš, kaj bi bilo, če bi bilo drugače (If I had a boat, I'd row across), daš nasvet (If I were you, I'd wait) in to ločiš od If it rains, I'll stay.
goal.de: Du sagst, was wäre, wenn es anders wäre (If I had a boat, I'd row across), gibst einen Rat (If I were you, I'd wait) und unterscheidest das von If it rains, I'll stay.
goal.it: Dici che cosa succederebbe se le cose fossero diverse (If I had a boat, I'd row across), dai un consiglio (If I were you, I'd wait) e lo distingui da If it rains, I'll stay.
goal.en: You can say what would be if things were different (If I had a boat, I'd row across), give advice (If I were you, I'd wait) and tell it from If it rains, I'll stay.

say.sl: Kar ni tako ali se skoraj gotovo ne bo zgodilo: **if** + preteklik, v drugem delu **would**. **If I had a boat, I'd row across.** (Če bi {m:imel|f:imela} čoln, bi {m:veslal|f:veslala} čez.) Čolna nimam. **If Jack lived nearer, he'd come more often.** (Če bi Jack živel bliže, bi prihajal pogosteje.) Preteklik tu ne pomeni *prej*, ampak *ni zares*. **'d** je **would**.
say.de: Was nicht so ist oder kaum sein wird: **if** + Vergangenheit, im anderen Teil **would**. **If I had a boat, I'd row across.** (Wenn ich ein Boot hätte, würde ich hinüberrudern.) Ich habe keines. **If Jack lived nearer, he'd come more often.** (Wenn Jack näher wohnte, käme er öfter.) Die Vergangenheit heißt hier nicht *früher*, sondern *nicht wirklich*. **'d** ist **would**.
say.it: Ciò che non è così o quasi certamente non sarà: **if** + il passato, **would** nell'altra parte. **If I had a boat, I'd row across.** (Se avessi una barca, remerei fino all'altra riva.) Non ce l'ho. **If Jack lived nearer, he'd come more often.** (Se Jack abitasse più vicino, verrebbe più spesso.) Il passato qui non vuol dire *prima*, ma *non davvero*. **'d** è **would**.
say.en: What isn't so, or probably won't be: **if** + the past, **would** in the other half. **If I had a boat, I'd row across.** (I haven't got one.) **If Jack lived nearer, he'd come more often.** (He lives far away.) The past here doesn't mean earlier: it means *not really*. **'d** is **would**.

examples.de: Wenn ich ein Boot hätte, würde ich hinüberrudern.
examples.it: Se avessi una barca, remerei fino all'altra riva.

say.sl: Drugi del ima lahko tudi **could** ali **might**, če je manj gotovo: **If it stopped raining, we could walk to the tarn.** (Če bi nehalo deževati, bi lahko šli do jezerca.) **If Sam sold the van, he might buy a horse.** (Če bi Sam prodal kombi, bi morda kupil konja.) Zanikanje kot običajno: **If I didn't have the sheep, I wouldn't get up at five.** (Če ne bi {m:imel|f:imela} ovc, ne bi {m:vstajal|f:vstajala} ob petih.)
say.de: Der andere Teil kann auch **could** oder **might** haben, wenn es weniger sicher ist: **If it stopped raining, we could walk to the tarn.** (Wenn es aufhörte zu regnen, könnten wir zum Bergsee gehen.) **If Sam sold the van, he might buy a horse.** (Wenn Sam den Lieferwagen verkaufte, würde er vielleicht ein Pferd kaufen.) Verneint wie immer: **If I didn't have the sheep, I wouldn't get up at five.** (Ohne die Schafe würde ich nicht um fünf aufstehen.)
say.it: L'altra parte può avere anche **could** o **might**, se è meno sicuro: **If it stopped raining, we could walk to the tarn.** (Se smettesse di piovere, potremmo andare al laghetto.) **If Sam sold the van, he might buy a horse.** (Se Sam vendesse il furgone, forse comprerebbe un cavallo.) Il negativo come sempre: **If I didn't have the sheep, I wouldn't get up at five.** (Se non avessi le pecore, non mi alzerei alle cinque.)
say.en: The other half can also have **could** or **might**, if it's less sure: **If it stopped raining, we could walk to the tarn.** **If Sam sold the van, he might buy a horse.** With not, as usual: **If I didn't have the sheep, I wouldn't get up at five.**

say.sl: Dela lahko zamenjata mesti, potem brez vejice: **I'd row across if I had a boat.** (Čez bi {m:veslal|f:veslala}, če bi {m:imel|f:imela} čoln.) Pri vprašanju gre **would** pred osebek: **What would you do if you won the raffle?** (Kaj bi {m:naredil|f:naredila}, če bi {m:zadel|f:zadela} na srečelovu?) **Where would you live if you could choose?** (Kje bi {m:živel|f:živela}, če bi lahko {m:izbral|f:izbrala}?)
say.de: Die Teile können tauschen, dann ohne Komma: **I'd row across if I had a boat.** (Ich würde hinüberrudern, wenn ich ein Boot hätte.) Bei der Frage kommt **would** vor das Subjekt: **What would you do if you won the raffle?** (Was würdest du machen, wenn du bei der Tombola gewinnen würdest?) **Where would you live if you could choose?** (Wo würdest du wohnen, wenn du wählen könntest?)
say.it: Le due parti possono scambiarsi, allora senza virgola: **I'd row across if I had a boat.** (Remerei fino all'altra riva, se avessi una barca.) Per chiedere, **would** va prima del soggetto: **What would you do if you won the raffle?** (Che cosa faresti se vincessi alla lotteria?) **Where would you live if you could choose?** (Dove abiteresti se potessi scegliere?)
say.en: The halves can change places, then with no comma: **I'd row across if I had a boat.** To ask, **would** goes before the subject: **What would you do if you won the raffle?** **Where would you live if you could choose?**

say.sl: Pri be pisno velja **were** za vse osebe: **If I were you, I'd ask Mrs Birkett.** (Na tvojem mestu bi {m:vprašal|f:vprašala} gospo Birkett.) To je nasvet. **If Meg were younger, she'd run faster.** (Če bi bila Meg mlajša, bi tekla hitreje.) Ljudje rečejo tudi **was**: *If I was you*, *If Meg was younger*. V govoru je to prav, pisno velja **were**.
say.de: Bei be gilt geschrieben **were** für alle Personen: **If I were you, I'd ask Mrs Birkett.** (An deiner Stelle würde ich Mrs Birkett fragen.) Das ist ein Rat. **If Meg were younger, she'd run faster.** (Wenn Meg jünger wäre, würde sie schneller laufen.) Man sagt auch **was**: *If I was you*, *If Meg was younger*. Gesprochen ist das richtig, geschrieben gilt **were**.
say.it: Con be per iscritto vale **were** per tutte le persone: **If I were you, I'd ask Mrs Birkett.** (Se fossi in te, chiederei a Mrs Birkett.) È un consiglio. **If Meg were younger, she'd run faster.** (Se Meg fosse più giovane, correrebbe più forte.) Si dice anche **was**: *If I was you*, *If Meg was younger*. A voce è giusto, per iscritto vale **were**.
say.en: With be, writing wants **were** for every person: **If I were you, I'd ask Mrs Birkett.** That's advice. **If Meg were younger, she'd run faster.** People also say **was**: *If I was you*, *If Meg was younger*. In talk that's right; writing wants **were**.

say.sl: **would** ostane v drugem delu: **If I had time, I'd help.** Slovenščina ima *bi* v obeh delih, pisno pa angleščina v enem: **If I knew the way, I'd tell you.** (Če bi {m:poznal|f:poznala} pot, bi ti {m:povedal|f:povedala}.) Marsikje ljudje rečejo tudi *If I would know*, in slišal boš to, pisno pa velja **If I knew**.
say.de: **would** bleibt im anderen Teil: **If I had time, I'd help.** Deutsch kann *wenn ich wissen würde* sagen, geschrieben im Englischen nicht: **If I knew the way, I'd tell you.** (Wenn ich den Weg wüsste, würde ich ihn dir sagen.) Manche Leute sagen auch *If I would know*, du wirst es hören, geschrieben gilt **If I knew**.
say.it: **would** resta nell'altra parte: **If I had time, I'd help.** Dopo se l'italiano ha il congiuntivo, l'inglese il semplice passato: **If I knew the way, I'd tell you.** (Se sapessi la strada, te la direi.) In certi posti si dice anche *If I would know*, lo sentirai, ma per iscritto vale **If I knew**.
say.en: **would** stays in the other half: **If I had time, I'd help.** **If I knew the way, I'd tell you.** In some places people also say *If I would know*, and you'll hear it, but writing wants **If I knew**.

say.sl: Primerjaj s prvim pogojem: **If I have time, I'll help.** (Morda bom {m:imel|f:imela} čas.) **If I had time, I'd help.** (Časa nimam.) **If it rains, I'll stay.** (Morda bo deževalo.) **If it rained, I'd stay.** (Mislim, da ne bo.) Tisti, ki govori, izbere, kako resnično se mu zdi.
say.de: Vergleiche mit der ersten Bedingung: **If I have time, I'll help.** (Vielleicht habe ich Zeit.) **If I had time, I'd help.** (Ich habe keine.) **If it rains, I'll stay.** (Es kann regnen.) **If it rained, I'd stay.** (Ich glaube nicht, dass es regnet.) Wer spricht, wählt danach, wie wirklich es ihm scheint.
say.it: Confronta con la prima condizione: **If I have time, I'll help.** (Forse avrò tempo.) **If I had time, I'd help.** (Non ne ho.) **If it rains, I'll stay.** (Può piovere.) **If it rained, I'd stay.** (Non credo che pioverà.) Chi parla sceglie da quanto gli sembra reale.
say.en: Set it beside the first conditional: **If I have time, I'll help.** (I may have.) **If I had time, I'd help.** (I haven't.) **If it rains, I'll stay.** (It may well rain.) **If it rained, I'd stay.** (I don't think it will.) You choose by how real it looks to you.

translation.sl: — Kaj bi {m:naredil|f:naredila}, če bi {m:imel|f:imela} veliko denarja, Wilf? — Če bi imel veliko denarja, bi kupil gostilno Packhorse. — In če je gospa Birkett ne bi hotela prodati? — Dal bi ji več! Na tvojem mestu se ne bi smejal, Sam. Če bi imel kaj pameti, bi tudi ti varčeval.
translation.de: — Was würdest du machen, wenn du viel Geld hättest, Wilf? — Wenn ich viel Geld hätte, würde ich das Packhorse Inn kaufen. — Und wenn Mrs Birkett es nicht verkaufen wollte? — Ich würde ihr mehr geben! An deiner Stelle würde ich nicht lachen, Sam. Wenn du Verstand hättest, würdest du dein Geld auch sparen.
translation.it: — Che cosa faresti se avessi molti soldi, Wilf? — Se avessi molti soldi, comprerei il Packhorse Inn. — E se Mrs Birkett non volesse venderlo? — Le darei di più! Se fossi in te, Sam, non riderei. Se avessi un po' di buon senso, risparmieresti anche tu.
translation.en: — What would you do if you had a lot of money, Wilf? — If I had a lot of money, I would buy the Packhorse Inn. — And if Mrs Birkett didn't want to sell it? — I would give her more! If I were you, Sam, I wouldn't laugh. If you had any sense, you'd save your money too.
